name: atomic-plan-rm
body: Atomic plan removal: the transient plan store is a single `apg/.trans/plans/<project>.jsonl`, so `apg plan rm <project> --force` (and every plan mutation) must be a whole-record rewrite through `write_through`. A cascade must never leave a half-deleted plan (no task without its phase, no edge to a removed record); a failure mid-removal leaves the original file exactly intact.
